title: The Apple Health cards held their access mode in three side-by-side properties, and a failed first read after an access reset drew Open Settings
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/AppleHealthMetrics/LiveAccess.swift: one LiveAccess union (unknown, needsAccess, granted, read) changed only by transition; LiveHealth.needsAccess and hasRead deleted. Checks: LiveAccessTests.testEveryStateMeetsEveryEvent_US56_AC5d (every state x event), LiveHealthTests.testAFailedFirstReadAfterAnAccessResetShowsNoRow_US56_AC5d (failed first). US-56 AC5d; iPhone survey S4, 2026-11-11
